To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the addition of STF to Kevlar fabric enhances the energy absorption and the ballistic performance of the composite.
the addition of STF with 15, 35, and 45 wt% nanosilica to Kevlar fabric improves its impact performance, but the addition of 25 wt% nanosilia STF reduces its impact performance.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the ballistic performance and energy absorption of Kevlar composites impregnated with shear thickening fluid made by nanosilica and PEG.
the effect of STF impregnation on the ballistic limit and the specific energy absorption of Kevlar fabrics.
the development of a new generation of STF/Kevla composite material with improved ballistic performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the energy absorption of Kevlar/STF composites can be significantly improved by the presence of nanosilka particles in STF.
the energy absorption of Kevlar fabrics impregnated by nanosilica-STF is significantly improved and the ballistic limit of the composite is improved up to 2.3 folds.
the STF impregnated Kevlar composites show a significant increase in the energy absorption and ballistic performance compared to the neat Kevlar fabric.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
by increasing silica nanoparticle loading in the STF, the shear thickening effect is enhanced and consequently the impact resistance of the Kevlar composite is enhanced.
the addition of STF to Kevlar fabric increases the energy absorption and SEA, and by increasing nanosila loading, the energy absorpotion increases.
the addition of STF to the woven Kevlar fabrics improves the energy absorption and ballistic performance of the composites.

STF can be an effective material in enhancing impact performance of Kevlara fabric.
